title: Foreign nationals — missing, rescued, or contacted (NDRRMA, 1 Sep)
body: NDRRMA (1 Sep 2026): for foreign nationals missing, rescued, or contacted after the Bhote Koshi flood in Rasuwa, see the Department of Tourism tourist list and the attached situation update PDF (final update dated 30 August 2026, 19:00). Open the originals — we do not copy names here.
